# OutSystems UI

> OutSystems UI is a browser-side library providing TypeScript behaviors and SCSS for 70+ UI patterns. The build emits one AMD JS bundle and one CSS bundle per platform target (O11 and ODC).

## Theme Migration

The CSS layer was rebuilt on design tokens (`--token-*`), a framework theme layer (`--color-*`, `--border-radius-*`, `--space-*`), and a per-component CSS API (`--osui-*`). Customer apps with custom CSS may need migration.

- [THEME-MIGRATION-GUIDE.md](THEME-MIGRATION-GUIDE.md): Complete migration guide — retired variables, replacement mappings, dark-mode fixes, recipes. Feed this file alongside the customer's CSS to migrate it.
